BetterTube: a privacy-friendly YouTube client for Android, forked from [LibreTube](https://github.com/libre-tube/LibreTube), with audio-only mode that really saves data and a redesigned, calmer interface.

## Install

Download **`BetterTube-v0.2.0.apk`** below and open it on your phone. Android may ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager. BetterTube installs alongside the official LibreTube app.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **First signed release.** v0.2.0 is an optimised release build (about half the size of the previews, and faster), signed with BetterTube's private key. Future releases update it in place.
>
> It's a separate app from the v0.1.x previews, so move over once:
> 1. In the old BetterTube: Settings → Backup and restore → **Backup**, and save the file.
> 2. Install v0.2.0 (a second BetterTube icon appears).
> 3. In the new BetterTube: Settings → Backup and restore → **Restore**, and pick the backup.
> 4. Uninstall the old BetterTube.

## What's new since the first preview

- **New in v0.1.12:** switching back to a tab shows what was there instantly (Home, Subscriptions, Library), no reload; pull down to refresh for new content
- **New in v0.1.11:** the audio player takes deep colours from each video's artwork (no banding), with a lit gradient play button, bigger controls and swipe down to minimise; the mini player and video page pick up the video's colours
- **New in v0.1.11:** one-tap Watch later (video page, audio ⋮ menu, video options), with Undo
- **New in v0.1.11:** snappier tab switching, light haptics
- **Fixed in v0.1.11:** shared links ignored while BetterTube was open, jump when collapsing to the mini player, chevron alignment; About/Help links now point to BetterTube
- **New in v0.1.10:** audio mode is remembered: after switching to audio, new videos also start as audio until you switch back (Settings → General → Remember audio mode)
- **New in v0.1.10:** thicker audio progress bar; tapping the artwork no longer pauses
- **Fixed in v0.1.10:** a grey block following the minimised video player
- **New in v0.1.9:** an Audio pill on the video (next to fullscreen) mirrors the Video pill on the audio artwork; the action row now fits without scrolling
- **New in v0.1.9:** audio controls sit higher and centred, the description opens as a panel on top
- **Fixed in v0.1.9:** header sliver above the video after switching from audio, chevron alignment, separator dot visibility, dark content showing behind the dock and mini player, landscape audio layout
- **New in v0.1.8:** the audio player uses the video page's layout (artwork in the video's spot, tap the title for the description, current chapter under the title, a Video pill on the artwork) with a smooth transition between audio and video
- **New in v0.1.8:** short ages in video lists (7h, 3d), quieter video details and headings, tighter Home spacing, the dock sits higher, a small + pill in Library, one standard search icon
- **New in v0.1.7:** more breathing room between the audio player's controls and the Comments row
- **New in v0.1.6:** calmer audio player: the Video toggle (and Chapters, when available) sits at the top above the artwork, giving the controls and the new Comments row more room; share, save and download are in ⋮
- **New in v0.1.5:** playback errors no longer close the player; BetterTube retries automatically from the same position, with a Retry button if that doesn't work
- **Fixed in v0.1.4:** tapping the data label in the audio player could start a video from the screen behind the player
- **Fixed in v0.1.3:** opening the Library tab crashed the app in v0.1.2-preview
- **One design language:** the mini player's darker tone and soft accent gradient now carry across the dock, chips, Subscribe / Play all / play buttons and the tonal buttons
- **Dock:** the active tab glows instead of sitting in a pill
- **Library:** your watch history is the main feed, with carousels of your playlists and bookmarks on top; the + for new playlists sits next to the Playlists heading, clear of the dock and mini player
- **Subscriptions:** the filter row is hidden by default (Settings → Appearance → *Subscriptions toolbar* to show it)
- **Data label:** shows the total only, no tap interaction
- **Audio player:** back chevron and ⋮ menu are the same size
- **Updates:** LibreTube's update checker is off; Settings → *BetterTube releases* opens this repository's releases page

## Highlights

**Audio-only that saves data:** switching to audio-only mid-video stops video downloads for real. A small data label in both players (🎬 / 🔊 + total) shows how much data the current video has used.

**A new design:**
- Plus Jakarta Sans typeface throughout
- Floating, icons-only dock with a soft colour sheen and a glow on the active tab; content flows underneath
- Header that scrolls away with the content
- New feed cards, flat chips, quiet empty states, everything on one 16dp grid
- Redesigned Home, Subscriptions, Library, Search, Channel, Playlist, video page, comments, sheets, dialogs and settings headings

**Motion:**
- Screens rise into place
- Lists ease in item by item
- Cards respond to touch
- The thumbnail you tap fades straight into the video instead of a black screen

**Players:**
- Minimal audio player with a blurred-artwork backdrop (Android 12+)
- Video page actions trimmed to Share, Save, Download; Audio and Video pills on the picture switch modes
- Calmer video controls, with autoplay moved into the ⚙ menu
- Floating mini player card above the dock

**Fixes:** a minimised player no longer switches video when you tap the screen behind it.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/capheproject/BetterTube#changelog).
